title: Three-Qubit Quantum Fourier Transform
caption: Quantum Fourier transform on three qubits. R_k denotes the controlled phase rotation diag(1, exp(2πi / 2^k)); the final SWAP restores the qubit order. This transform is the core subroutine of phase estimation and Shor's algorithm.
reference_check: unitary equals qft3 up to global phase
